content.subject: Volunteers needed for book sale
content.body: Our library is looking for volunteers to help with the book sale coming up this weekend. We need individuals to help in all areas. If you're interested, please tell us how you'd like to help with the book sale. Let me know if you have any questions.
content.instruction: Respond to the e-mail. In your e-mail, give one piece of information and ask TWO questions.

content.subject: Employee awards dinner
content.body:
Hi Susan,
I'm coordinating the employee awards dinner this year. I know you've done this in the past. Can you tell about your experience planning previous dinners? Also, l'd appreciate any suggestions that you may have.
John Dembo
content.instruction: Respond to the e-mail. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information and make ONE suggestion.
